prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a high-resolution 1800 by 1800 square editorial photograph for Thrive in Order's home-organizing website. The attached image is a WEBSITE MOCKUP and is supplied only as a composition and photographic subject reference. Regenerate ONLY the linen cupboard photograph shown in the lower left of that mockup. The final output must be one full-frame photograph, no website, text, user interface, border, rounding, or page margins.

Match the image faithfully: open natural oak linen cupboard, practical accessible shelves, orderly cream towels folded with slight natural variation, a few muted olive green towels, several real woven storage baskets holding linens and household essentials, subtle everyday bathroom supplies on one shelf. A green trailing houseplant descends along the left side. Warm natural morning sunlight from the left, realistic wood grain, woven fibers and soft textiles, restrained green and cream palette. A welcoming practical household space, not a sterile commercial showroom. Straight-on camera angle, cupboard filling most of the square frame, similar to the approved photograph. Keep every visible shelf functional and believable, avoid repeated identical fake objects. No people, product labels, logos, typography or watermark. Opaque full-frame image at asset resolution.
